## Richer attachments, avatar menus and model controls

Nova Desktop 0.12.0 adds file, folder, project-file and drawing attachments, restores model configuration in personality and Team modes, and fixes the inline Teams form and floating rail toggles.

### Attachments

- The paperclip opens a menu for files, folders, project files, and a sketch or mockup. Folder selection adds a path without replacing the workspace; selecting the workspace itself attaches `./`.
- The Files pane offers **Attach file** for the displayed file and **Attach folder** in the folder view. Unsaved editor changes stay in the editor; attaching a dirty file explicitly refers to the saved version on disk.
- The canvas supports pencil, rectangle, line and text tools, color and stroke controls, Undo and Clear. Clearing can be undone, and cancelling a drawing asks before discarding it. Keyboard users can move the drawing cursor with arrows and start/end a shape with Space.
- **Attach drawing** saves a PNG under `.nova/attachments` and adds its path to the existing prompt. The backend bounds PNG input, checks the workspace, resolves storage paths through WorkspaceGuard, and writes a unique file without overwriting an existing one.
- Attachments append to the draft belonging to the original task, including after switching tasks. A dismissed picker leaves the draft alone.

Attachments remain editable paths in the prompt. The selected harness reads those paths; selecting an image does not add a new image-upload protocol.

### Models and personality

- The personality menu shows avatars for Nova, Serena, Ralph and Nora, plus a combined team avatar. Selected avatars also appear in the composer.
- The harness/model picker is visible with a personality selected. Its changes configure that personality instead of silently changing the base chat.
- In Team mode the picker includes member buttons so each member's harness, model and reasoning effort can be configured directly. The existing search, recent models and harness catalogs remain available.

### Interface fixes

- Clicking the active Files, GitHub, Board or Preview rail icon again collapses its panel back to Chat. Pane state stays mounted, preserving file drafts and browser state. Terminal and Running agents keep their existing toggle behavior.
- Inline Teams configuration now shares Settings form styles: descriptions sit below labels, controls have consistent dimensions, rows wrap at narrow widths, and the form uses a bounded readable width.
- Approval, personality and attachment menus share keyboard navigation, focus handling and native popover dismissal.

### Validation

Frontend tests, lint/build, Rust formatting/Clippy and Rust tests; Windows/WebView2 app assertions for avatars, personality/team model selection, rail toggles, project-file attachment, mouse/keyboard drawing, Undo/Clear/discard protection, PNG saving and workspace/input refusal. The app smoke suite also exercises all 36 Desktop tools, five window sizes, five workspace views and nine Settings sections. Packaged checks exercise the production CSP and Files editor.

### Limits

Drawings are exported PNGs, not editable drawing project files. Attachments name saved files and folders; unsaved source edits are not uploaded or saved automatically. Plan mode still requires Codex.

Native folder selection was opened in the built app, but automated confirmation of a selection could not be completed. Folder path formatting is covered by Rust tests; the final native selection still needs a manual check.
